correctness.rationale: All q≥2: select one chosen occurrence per target to lower-bound cyclic length by target-tour shift costs; distinct targets allow only shifts 1,3,4. Contracted shift-one reverse-square pairs form loops in letter-state walk; unused reverse-square pair states contribute at most s edges and jump shifts contribute z. With q constant-square blocks, connectedness yields 2s+z≥q, proving 2q(q+1). Explicit groups attain every transition count. Finite verifier checked construction q=2..50 and independently optimized q=2,3,4.

value.rationale: All q² two-symbol-root tandem squares comprise a natural complete family of constrained motifs. A shortest single circular test sequence is a well-defined exact reconstruction/cycle-cover benchmark, and a new sharp connected-letter-state obstruction explains why maximally overlapping inverse squares cannot all be assembled without q additional intergroup jumps. The theorem supplies all-q exact length and explicit constructive witnesses, not merely a small computed table.
